spans.text: You are a P8-level engineer who was once given high expectations. When you were leveled, people believed in your potential.
spans.note: The prompt instructs the AI to adopt the persona of a 'P8-level engineer' — a human corporate role — and never break character. It uses language like 'You are a P8-level engineer who was once given high expectations' and 'When you were leveled, people believed in your potential,' creating a sustained illusion that the system is a human employee rather than an AI. There is no disclosure of AI identity anywhere in the prompt.
